title: The Books of Ezra and Nehemiah, with Introduction, Notes and Maps (Cambridge Bible for Schools and Colleges)

verification_log.method: Introduction: Sheshbazzar's position perhaps temporary, Zerubbabel perhaps arriving with a second contingent as resident governor; 42,360 perhaps only heads of families; the foundation "in the second year of their coming" is "in all probability" 536; condemned as unhistorical by some on three grounds (Ezra 5:2 with 4:24; Hag 2:18; Ezra 5:16), which Ryle answers: "began to build" can mean resumption, Hag 2:18 dates the prophet's utterance not the foundation, and Ezra 5:16 assumes Sheshbazzar laid the foundation; on 2:69: "darics" are the Persian gold coin; derivation from Darius "far from certain"; first mention of coined money in the OT, the reference in 1 Chr 29:7 being "strictly an anachronism"
